messages.subject: Energy & Resources Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Richard,

Your leadership of Miramar's Energy and Chemicals practice across renewables, energy, oil and gas, climate technology and commodities makes this a highly relevant introduction. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy and resources growth depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
